project_extensions.scope: Local statistical run-record conventions; no event generation and thus no Collider Monte Carlo extension.

acceptance_criteria: Pinned official DDCalc and signed compiler artifacts; actual official and scoped native binary outputs.
Positive official signal and scoped driver agreement to 1e-10, Nobs=0, fixed b=0.36 and independent Poisson residual at most 1e-10.
18 independent SHM comparisons at most 2e-12 s/km, native vmin at most 1e-9 km/s, and exact cutoff zeros.
Byte-identical replay and cutoff negative control.
